title: useBoolean Hook
description:
Implement a `useBoolean` hook that returns `{ value, setTrue, setFalse, toggle }`. The boolean starts at `initial` (default `false`).

**Example:**
```tsx
const { value, setTrue, setFalse, toggle } = useBoolean(false);
```
ai_context: Common mistake: implementing toggle as setValue(!value) rather than setValue(v => !v), which reads stale closure state when called multiple times before a re-render.
